_doc: Combat value of what an item does each round, for the gear advisor's proc scorer (service advice). TWO kinds, summed into one expected-damage-per-round score at _level_ref, then * (itemLevel/_level_ref) * _global (superseding the flat +50). (1) <props>combatcast</props> -- spells cast in combat: a CLEAN DAMAGE NUKE carries NO entry here, its value derives automatically from its <tier> (spell_proc_tier_value) discounted by _save_factor -- retune a tier in the skill XML and the score follows. Only spells whose real worth does NOT follow their tier carry an explicit override below: %HP or HP-of-wearer damage, multi-hit, damage-over-time, alignment-gated anti-evil (scorer is align-blind, so population-weighted), tierless effect/buff/heal (a self-heal negates the opponent's DPS; ~0.75 over-heal discount), and heating (tier but no direct damage). (2) <props>combathits</props> [{one_hit,multi_hit,chance}] -- EXTRA melee attacks an item's onFight fires: each swing scores _hit_value, a multi_hit is _round_attacks swings. KNOBS: _global maps expected-damage to gear-score currency (calibrated on fireball's TRUE mean, which the engine truncates -- fireball ~502, not the old 550); _level_ref is the reference item level; _save_factor is the damage kept after an average save (tier-derived values only; overrides bake in their own save reality); _hit_value is one extra melee swing at ref level, rider-inclusive; _round_attacks is swings per multi_hit. All live-tunable. See COMBAT_PROC_SCORING.md.
